before_times: Who is the session for: the student, a parent, or both? What's the goal: a plan, essays, or a visit?
Roughly when, and how many people?
At the office, by video or phone, or at your home?
after_time: The student's grade and the year of applications, in a few words.
Anything that helps the meeting, like a step-free way in.
secure_page_only: The student's grades, test scores and school records the family chooses to share
Learning needs or accommodations, only if the family chooses to share them
Family budget and aid questions, for the advisor's plan only
The advisor's terms, the parent's consent, and whether the advisor may keep a copy of an essay (no by default)
The student's name as it appears on school records, and the parent's name as booker
intake_questions.who_may_book: A parent or guardian books for a student under 18 and pays. A student may book alone only at 18 or older. A parent may not book for an adult student.

stop.words: someone in danger or hurt right now, at school, at home or anywhere
stop.say: If anyone is in danger, call 911, or the local emergency number.

stop.words: crisis words, from the student or a parent
a student who says an adult is hurting them
stop.say: Call 911 now, or the local child-protection line. Rosie never takes a report.

go_on.words: a family dispute over who may see the student's records
go_on.what: the advisor follows the papers on file, asks the parent who may book, and never tells one parent what the other shared.

first_steps_and_forms.prep: Have the student's grades, the list of schools, the deadlines and the test dates ready.

required.name: The advisor's terms and the family's consent form
required.who: the parent, on the secure page
required.result: signed: on file for later sessions

staff.licenses_or_certificates: None needed. Experience is the advisor's own word, shown as stated.
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs any price made for one family.
staff.stand_in: Another advisor who knows the student's list; a family that asked for their advisor by name is asked first; nobody moves on silence.
staff.roles: Advisors (some with teaching or counseling-office experience, shown as their own word), a front desk person.

children_and_age.who_may_book: A parent or guardian books for a student under 18 and pays. A student may book alone only at 18 or older. A parent may not book for an adult student.
children_and_age.minors_texts: A student under 18 is never texted directly by Rosie; the parent gets the texts.

visit.check_in: At the office: the code at the desk. By video or phone: the advisor asks for the code at the start. At home: the code at the door.
visit.done: The code, or DONE when the meeting ends.
visit.changes_at_visit: Extra time on a plan, an extra essay or a longer session is priced and OK'd before it's added.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
license.who: The business. No person license is needed by default.
license.ask: Any registration, certificate or insurance the business wants shown, as the business's own word.
license.insurance: The business's own choice, shown only as its own word.

never_in_a_text: A student's grades, test scores, school records, learning needs, family money or aid, health, and anything the family shares about the student's life.

pf.messages: card or document texted by mistake
